messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: hosted-api-us-east-1 p99 latency spike detected. Queue depth (inference requests) rising past 48k, drop rate increasing. autoscaler errors observed: 429 from cloud provider when creating GPUs. metric links: https://ops.redwood/metrics/hosted/queue?range=15m
frank: oncall here, acknowledging. estimated impact? any customers timing out? :raised_hand:
alice: seeing sustained backlog on hot-path model groups (gpt-like-xxl). p95 jumped from 220ms -> 2.6s, p99 ~ 8.2s. tail timeouts at 30s. logs show stuck provisioning calls: cloud-api create-instance -> 429 rate_limit.
dana: confirmed, provisioner stuck in backoff. repro of cloud errors:
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T03:21:12 provisioner.go:412 createInstance failed status=429 body="quota exceeded: GPUs"
```
ben: can we divert traffic to dedicated pools or lower-capacity variants?
carol: Dedicated pools have spare capacity in us-west-2 but routing policy prefers regional locality. we can fail-open to cross-region but increase latency for some users.
frank: two action tracks: 1) immediate triage to reduce customer impact 2) fix autoscaler/provisioner and request quota bump. prioritize (1).
alice: quick mitigations I can push now: - enable temporary global model downgrade on hot-path routes to smaller quantized shards - apply short-term per-key rate-limiter at edge for noisy keys - route 20% of traffic to rdw-dedicated-us-west pool
dana: prepping a canary config, posting patch:
```
# route override
route: /v1/generate
weight: {rdw-hosted-quantized-1: 0.8, rdw-dedicated-us-west: 0.2}
```
ben: I'll publish an emergency feature-flag with a 90s TTL. tagging @alice for rollback instructions.
eric: support: which customers hit 504s? seeing top offenders: startup-xyz (heavy bursts), internal sandbox tests from integrator accounts. notifying PMs.
frank: communicate to status page if we have customer-visible timeouts. carol, can you confirm the status page wording?
carol: status draft: "We are experiencing elevated request latencies and intermittent timeouts for hosted API in us-east-1 due to GPU provisioning failures. Mitigations in progress; some traffic is being routed to alternate capacity. Updates every 15 minutes." anyone object? :+1:
alice: rolling the downgrade now. command:
```
./deploy-tool apply --env=hosted-us-east --patch=quantize-hotpath-20260315
```
alice: patch applied, measuring. p95 dropping to ~1.1s after 30s, queue depth plateauing at ~30k. p99 down to ~4.5s. good sign.
dana: provisioner still returning 429s, cloud team says quota reached for GPUs in region. I opened a support ticket and a rapid quota-request but ETA unknown. ticket: PROD-78921.
ben: enabling edge rate-limit for noisy keys now. config:
```
quota: per-key-per-minute: 60
action: 429
```
ben: applied. some backlog draining, but tail still noisy.
eric: customer impact update: most customers see degraded latency rather than full failures after the downgrade/reroute. a handful of heavy burst customers still hit 504s; we've flagged those for manual throttles.
frank: summary for handoff to night SRE (ben): - root cause: GPU quota exhaustion in us-east-1 causing autoscaler/provisioner 429s - mitigations done: model downgrade (quantized) on hot path, 20% reroute to dedicated us-west, per-key rate limits - outstanding: quota bump request, longer-term autoscaler backoff fixes and better cross-region failover policy - customer impact: elevated p95/p99 and some 504s for high-burst customers - runbook items: temporary routing stays until quota confirmed by cloud (TBD)
ben: taking over for next shift. I will monitor queue depth and liaise with cloud support. please add any follow-ups to the thread. setting pager silence for other non-related alerts.
sre-bot: INC-20260315-023: incident transitioned to "mitigated" -> oncall: ben. timeline link: https://ops.redwood/incidents/INC-20260315-023
carol: postmortem owner? alice volunteers to lead. propose RCA sections: autoscaler assumptions, quota telemetry blind spots, routing policy improvements, customer throttle strategy.
alice: will own postmortem. initial blameless notes: cloud quotas saturated due to simultaneous bursty customers + provisioner retry amplification. need better proactive quota monitoring and faster fallback to alternate pools.
eric: notifications: support will send targeted emails to affected customers with mitigation notes. draft ready if needed.
frank: thanks team. if anything regresses ping @ben. closing active pager for me. :white_check_mark:
ben: acknowledged, monitoring dashboard pinned. will update status page in 15m or on any change.
incident-bot: NOTE: automated alert suppression enabled for 10m to avoid noise during manual mitigation window."
